author: Zintenka
body:
At first it was planned to be Luar II, but then i realized that I'd be too much of a hassle to get in contact with him over a map. So i decided that its not worth it.

So with the help of some ppl we renamed it and made it similar to Shiver and Axis. In terms of spawning that is.

Features:
  • Kits
  • Iron and kills give you xp bottles
  • 3 monuments
  • 80 players 40v40
  • Secret shtuff
Vid by vsplesk!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4_VNIT-SZ4

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Overall the map looks pretty neat. I like the block palette and I like the layout of the map. From the pictures it also looks like the map has classes so if they are balanced, it could work out really nice.

I really like the iron supply. There is enough Iron even for later in the game but one thing that might screw with the gameplay a little bit is the diamond blocks. I am not saying you should remove them because they might turn out great but it could also go the other way and be horrible.

Now some things I think could be improved. Height difference. I don't see a lot / any height differences on the map. Having some areas go underground could be a nice gameplay feature but you would also have to make the islands be more layers. Even with that I think the frontline areas could be lifted a couple blocks up.

The suggar canes are a nice addition to the map, but there is a lot of them at one spot and on the other there is none. Having them on multiple areas around could help the map aestheticly if you find good spots for them otherwise it might be better just to remove them and replace them with some other decoration.

But even with the things said above about the height and reeds the map looks fantastic and looks like it could have awesome gameplay! Good Job!
